body: The sync is a real two-parent merge whose parents are the build branch's tip and the upstream commit taken; never a rebase, a squash or a cherry-pick series, and the merge base is the last sync's upstream commit.

Each commit left out is named with its reason; in a two-parent merge a left-out commit stays an ancestor, so leaving it out means undoing its change in the merge's tree, and a reason that no longer holds puts the commit back in.

The standing left-out set is re-read against the upstream commit taken: parley_code_editor kept out of the workspace, upstream's AGENTS.md files kept out of the tree, and the Dioxus 0.8 move held at 0.7.3 while upstream pins 0.8.0-alpha.3.

The Dioxus hold is re-read with its residuals res-xpkmxnvl and res-xchmbfjr and the keyboard_compat coverage exclusion; whether Dioxus 0.8 is released and the hold's cost both ways are measured, and the hold is an operator fork.

Every boundary widening the merge brings, the Dioxus hold and every left-out commit go into one founder-forks evidence file, each with what crosses, the rule of ours it meets, its options with their measured cost and its dependences on the others, checked against the escalate patterns; none is answered by a default, and technical forks go to the operator as dialogs.

The take changes layout behaviour: display: contents is seen through when testing whether a box is or contains a block, display: contents pseudo-elements are generated and wrapping is inline-only; it is ratified as an upstream engine behaviour change of this take, and both layout modes still give identical layouts.
The take changes style-to-layout conversion: float keyword sizes and logical float and clear sides are converted for Taffy, ratified as an upstream behaviour change of this take.
The take changes inline layout of a textarea: its text is laid out once its width is known, a change to deferred inline construction ratified per take.
The take adds painting of the IME preedit underline in text decoration, beside escher's explicit text-decoration geometry and the embolden witness, ratified per take.
The take adds DOMTokenList.replace to the JS bootstrap's DOM interfaces in the script runtime, ratified per take.

The take changes upstream's WPT tooling — the diff-to-PR helper and its tests, the WPT workflow's Pages artifact named per run attempt, and the WPT commit pin — tooling the WPT runner mirrors from upstream and that stays upstream-only.

Conflicts keep both sides' intent: the changed set's contract, the clock invariant, the select model and its list, the hit stops and scrolled-box bounds, the into-view readings, the stable ids and the snapshot, the range and keyboard models, inert, the accessibility state reads, the stamped sub-resource request and the file: refusal, the buffered render, and the escher crates and seven_guis workspace members; no workaround is bought only to keep upstream code untouched.
Where a resolution keeps an escher addition inside a merged upstream body, the fork's additions stay in functions of escher's own.
A lock move the merge or a fork's option makes is measured by a locked workspace build beside the dependency audit, never by the audit alone; cargo legs run locked.
A take carries upstream's coupled dependency pins as one set or holds the set; holding a pin upstream moved is an undo named with its reason; no dependency is bumped beyond upstream's own set.
The workspace takes no git dependency save Taffy's pinned revision.

CI workflow edits keep every action pinned to a 40-hex commit SHA and the CI workflow's read-only contents permission; upstream's workflow files stay guarded by the repository check so upstream CI resources are reached only from upstream; the CI contract tests pin this.
MSRV stays 1.91 unless a taken pin requires more, then named.
The chunk adds no crate, port, environment variable or listener of escher's own.
Upstream's new test files run under the blitz-tests rule of one file and one target per behaviour, the new mod line in the aggregate target included, held by the targets check.

Every escher proof passes after the merge: the fast and doc legs, the stand checks in both layout modes, the incremental and non-incremental oracle, the a11y leg, the dependency audit, the embolden witness, and the screenshot and cross-OS readings, a moved reading re-measured and recorded, never loosened; fork CI green on the pushed commit with every job settled.

Every advisory ignore in the dependency audit names its residual row: the RUSTSEC-2026-0192 reason is re-pointed to name res-y4gizreq, not the wait alone.

The dependency set taken whole: upstream's pins are one coupled set taken or held; holding Dioxus at 0.7.3 while upstream pins 0.8.0-alpha.3 is an undo of upstream's change, named with its reason and its cost both ways measured.
Locked builds: any lock move the merge or a fork's option makes is measured by a locked workspace build beside the audit, never by the audit alone.
The dependency audit gate with cargo-deny and its licence gate stay green after the merge, run locally before the push.
Advisory ignores by ID with a written reason: the RUSTSEC-2026-0192 ignore's reason is re-pointed to name its owning residual row, res-y4gizreq.

The WPT PR lookup by head sha and marker-bounded splice, and the WPT post-results workflow running trusted scripts, are changed by the take and must still hold.

Layout construction changes (display: contents, pseudo-elements, inline-only wrapping, float sizes) reach the rules that a dropped anonymous block clears its children's parent, inline-box heights stay finite, and stale node ids never panic.

MSRV stays 1.91 unless a taken pin requires more, then named.

Every escher proof passes after the merge: the fast and doc legs, stand checks in both layout modes, the incremental oracle, the a11y leg, the audit, the locked fast leg's embolden witness, and screenshot and cross-OS readings re-measured and recorded, never loosened; fork CI green with every job settled.

body: The sync is a two-parent merge whose parents are this branch's tip and upstream's 165d698c3; conflicts are measured on a fresh trial worktree under the build directory with rerere disabled.

A left-out commit stays an ancestor and its change is undone in the merge's tree, named with its reason; the standing left-out set (parley_code_editor out of the workspace, upstream's agent guide excluded, Dioxus held) is re-read against the new tip, and a reason that no longer holds puts the commit back in.

Dioxus stays held at 0.7.3 against upstream's 0.8 alpha pin unless the operator's fork rules otherwise: the buffered render on the Dioxus 0.7 bridge, upstream's buffered-render test kept as written, upstream's mounted-flush test left out and the keyboard_compat coverage exclusion are re-read at this sync.

Every boundary widening, the Dioxus hold and every left-out commit go into one operator forks file, each with what crosses, the rule of ours it meets, options with their measured cost and dependences on the others, checked against the escalate patterns; none is answered by a default, and technical forks reach the operator as dialogs.
Any lock move is measured by a locked workspace build beside the dependency audit, never by the audit alone; cargo legs run locked.

Coupled dependency pins are taken as one set or held, a held pin named as an undo with its reason; no git dependency save Taffy's pinned rev, no bump beyond upstream's own set, MSRV stays 1.91 unless a taken pin requires more, then named.

Taken layout behaviour — display: contents in box construction and pseudo-elements, the block test through contents, float keyword sizes and logical float/clear sides, a textarea's text laid out once its width is known, the damage marks — must hold in both layout modes and under the incremental/non-incremental differential oracle.
Taken paint behaviour — the IME preedit underline — reaches pixels: screenshot and cross-OS readings that move are re-measured and recorded, never loosened; the embolden witness re-read.
DOMTokenList.replace joins the vibey-script runtime with upstream's DOM test.

Upstream's new display_contents and ime_preedit_underline test files and the aggregate entry's new mod line run under this fork's blitz-tests rule — one file and one target per behaviour — held by the blitz-tests targets check and the blitz-tests manifest's difference from upstream.

Upstream's WPT tooling (the diff-to-PR script and its unittest, the WPT workflow's per-attempt Pages artifact, the WPT pin) is taken: the workflow keeps every action pinned to a 40-hex SHA and stays guarded by github.repository, ci.yml keeps contents: read, and WPT stays report-only.

Conflicts keep both sides' intent: the changed-set contract, the clock invariant, the select model and its list, the hit stops and scrolled-box bounds, the into-view readings, stable ids and the snapshot, the range and keyboard models, inert, the accessibility state reads, the stamped sub-resource request and the file: refusal, the buffered render, and the escher crates and seven_guis workspace members; no workaround bought only to keep upstream code untouched.

Every escher proof passes after the merge: the fast and doc legs (clippy over the workspace and upstream blitz-dom included), the stand checks in both layout modes with stand-repeat's zero-failure budget, the a11y leg, the dependency audit, and fork CI green on the pushed commit with every job settled.

The merge-surface residuals (the left-out table, the two Dioxus 0.8 move rows, and res-vuvpa25q, res-q4s3p5ga, res-kk4tzmi5, res-derughab, res-ipcah32k) are re-read against the merge; one a taken move resolves is re-measured, never assumed.
The sink allowlist is re-checked: the merged delta read for every new tracing or log call site, target, print and env read; the capture checks stay at 0 needles and third-party targets stay dropped.
Every advisory ignore in the dependency audit names its residual row: the RUSTSEC-2026-0192 reason re-pointed to res-y4gizreq instead of stating the wait alone.
The last wrap commit's CI verdict is unread and never folded as green; it is re-read at P3 and before this chunk's push, and new upstream tests moving a tally are attributed by test name.
No new crate, port, env var or listener of ours.
